notes: Product batch 8 (v1.11.40, the last approved batch — all 36 review ideas + 5 creative ideas now built): P3-13 sync as a real interface + Link Store — SyncProvider (list/create/update/delete/read_done/write_done) with GoogleSyncProvider, and LinkStore hiding uid_map/event_map/ical_map behind resolve(bid, uid); the push reads the whole programme window once at its start (one list call instead of one per box) and only when some box actually needs resolution. Creative 1 exam-day mode: on exam days the Today tab shows presence + start times (Maz 07:30/08:00), an editable venue address and a what-to-bring checklist (entry card, pen, ID), plus a «ثبت نتیجه» button opening the result form. Creative 2 reverse planning: pick an exam + a coverage target (50/70/90%) and the programme places one 90-minute test box per uncovered budget topic backwards from the exam into empty gaps of future days (max 2 parts/subject/day, 12h cap, tests before reviews, exam days skipped); the plan is shown first and nothing is created until «جای‌گذاری همه». Creative 3 efficiency-drop detection: useful/real below 50% for 2+ consecutive days with data shows a light-day suggestion (review + rest) on the dashboard — display-only. Creative 4 personal bests: best useful day, best test week and best chapter accuracy (≥10 solved tests) on the dashboard — self-comparison only, no rank estimation. Creative 5 Konkur coverage map: one colour map of the whole syllabus — every book chapter by testbook solved/total (green ≥80%, yellow 1–79%, grey 0%, «بدون داده» without a total) plus geometry and the general subjects from the nearest exam budget that covers them. New state key examPack; 45 new i18n keys (1189/1189).
